NVDA is trading at $229.38. I will look for a bull put spread with short strike around 0.15-0.30 delta.
For the 2026-09-18 expiration (14 DTE), the NVDA260918P00220000 has a delta of -0.2563. The bid/ask is 2.55/2.57.
The NVDA260918P00215000 has a delta of -0.1689. The bid/ask is 1.52/1.55.
This creates a spread of 5. I will target the short strike at 220 and the long strike at 215.

The mid-price for the short put (NVDA260918P00220000) is (2.55 + 2.57) / 2 = 2.56.
The mid-price for the long put (NVDA260918P00215000) is (1.52 + 1.55) / 2 = 1.535.
Net credit = 2.56 - 1.535 = 1.025.
Max loss = (220 - 215) - 1.025 = 5 - 1.025 = 3.975.
Max loss per structure = 3.975 * 100 = $397.5.
1% of equity = 0.01 * 99997.95 = $999.9795. Max loss is within limits.
Bid/ask spread for short leg: (2.57 - 2.55) / 2.56 = 0.0078 or 0.78%, which is < 15%.
Bid/ask spread for long leg: (1.55 - 1.52) / 1.535 = 0.0195 or 1.95%, which is < 15%.

For the P_profit, the short strike delta of -0.2563 suggests a ~25.63% chance of expiring in the money. Therefore, the chance of expiring out of the money (profit) is 1 - 0.2563 = 0.7437. With the exit plan (take profit at 50% of credit, stop at 2x credit, close at 2 DTE), I will estimate a p_profit of 0.65.
